The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kleb Zellock]] operated a '''criminal organization''' in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. He operated out of [[Doodnik's Café]] in the frontier [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Tyne's Horky (town)|Tyne's Horky]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyne's Horky|of the same name]]. His organization dealt in [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], claim-jumping and [[Blaster/Legends|gun]]-running. In 15 BBY, local miner [[Jann Tosh]] and his trusty [[Droid/Legends|droid]] sidekicks [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] brought Zellock to justice.
